title: euphrasia stricta var. suecica
intro: Euphrasia stricta var. suecica, commonly known as Swedish Eyebright, is a subspecies of the Euphrasia stricta plant, belonging to the family Scrophulariaceae. This plant is used in herbal medicine due to its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it effective in treating eye and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Swedish Eyebright include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight off infections, and exhibit expectorant properties, facilitating the removal of mucus from the lungs. The bioactive constituents of Swedish Eyebright include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
